AETHER / INTERFACE GUIDELINES

Built for the pilot.

Try Run demo for a guided tour, or select a scenario. Click a contact marker to acquire and scan it. Open POWER on the left display to redistribute energy.

Hide / show HUD
Esc
Close an open panel

Design principles

  1. Keep the central flight path clear.
  2. Use a stable hierarchy: flight → warnings → systems.
  3. Pair warning colour with a symbol and text.
  4. Use live text and vector geometry for crisp instruments.
  5. Separate simulation state from presentation.
  6. Offer readable contrast, scale, motion and keyboard controls.

Small decorative labels are secondary; essential flight readouts stay prominent. Test contrast against both dark space and bright terrain before integrating into flight.

References: Xbox contrast guidance ↗ · W3C pointer target guidance ↗
